# How bacteria copy themselves and change

> *How do bacteria pass on genes, swap them with each other, and become resistant to drugs?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
This unit is planned but not yet written. The outline below shows what it will cover.
:::

## Planned content

- Mutation and how often it happens
- Horizontal gene transfer: transformation, transduction, conjugation
- Bacteriophages, and how phage genes can change a bacterium
- Selection acts on variation that already exists

## Planned interactives

- A selection simulation on antibiotic plates
- A refutation unit on the belief that the body becomes resistant

**Links to other teaching:** Seeds the pharmacology block (resistance).
